parsed.explanation: Fixed 11 issues: 1) Escaped 6 unescaped ampersands (& -> &) in 'Janii & Tremellii', '& 1739', 'Tristiam & Epistolae', 'Graece & Latine' (Herodianus), 'Graece & Latine' (Elianus), 'Graeco Latinum & Lat.' - ampersands must be escaped in XML. 2) Fixed invalid BIBL nesting: The BIBL opened for 'Mohemii ... 4to' was never closed before the next BIBL 'Titus Livius' started, causing overlapping/nested BIBL elements. Added missing </BIBL> after <FORMAT>4to</FORMAT>. to properly close the Mohemii entry (10 BIBL opens but only 9 closes originally). 3) Fixed 4 mojibake character encodings: B\u221a\u00bacher -> Bücher, Prei\u221a\u00fc -> Preiß, 4t\u221a\u2264 -> 4to, 8v\u221a\u2264 -> 8vo.
